app.title: PsLauncher
toolbar.name: Main Toolbar
tooltip.clear_terminal: Clear all displayed content in the current terminal tab
tooltip.edit_save: Enter/Exit edit mode, save script changes
tooltip.edit_save_caps: Enter/Exit Edit Mode, Save Script Changes
tooltip.send_ctrl_c: Send Ctrl+C interrupt signal (0x03) to the current terminal process
tooltip.hide_to_tray: Hide window to system tray, restore window by clicking the tray icon
tooltip.run: Run the script of the currently focused tab
tooltip.stop: Stop the script of the currently focused tab (force terminate process tree)
tooltip.interrupt: Send Ctrl+C interrupt signal (0x03) to the current terminal process, used for graceful interruption of running scripts
tooltip.copy: Copy the selected text to the clipboard. If no text is selected, copy all text from the current focused tab.
tooltip.paste: Paste the clipboard content to the cursor position
tooltip.close_source: Close all read-only source code view tabs
tooltip.close_terminal: Close all terminal tabs, including running and finished ones
tooltip.close_all: Close all tabs. This will close all source code tabs and all terminal tabs. If a terminal is currently executing, it will be forcibly terminated. This may cause running programs or scripts to exit abnormally.

message.current_tab_not_terminal_clear: The current tab is not a terminal tab and cannot clear the screen.
